quotes: Your Mercenary needs maximum Resistances, Life Leech, a high damage Weapon, and high Defense and/or Damage Reduction to stay alive reliably. Cannot Be Frozen is also a great stat for maintaining Mercenary DPS and leech. Ethereal gear is preferred since it doesn't lose durability. Mercenary Types and Gear Options at each Gear Level perform equally well in different situations; choose based on Farming Spots and/or personal preference. Remember you can drag Healing Potions onto the portrait, or shift + 1/2/3/4 to directly feed them a Healing Potion from your Belt. The Mercenary also gains bonus Resistances from Thawing Potions and Antidote Potions. If your Mercenary dies in battle, you can revive them from any of the Mercenary NPCs in each Act. quotes: Shaftstop (Mesh Armor, ethereal; 15 IAS / 15 All Res jewel)
The Hybrid variant uses Hand of Justice and Dragon to have a Level 30 Holy Fire Aura on top of the Level 30 Holy Shock Aura provided by double Dreams.

With both high Fire and Lightning Damage on top of the Physical Damage provided by the Hand of Justice itself, this setup encounters virtually zero issues with Immunities. This is even more so the case if you use Crack of the Heavens and Flame Rift, a devastating combo on the Hybrid build. A Teleport Charges Amulet provides this variant with much needed mobility and repositioning ability given that it misses out on Enigma.

In order to maintain maximum Attack Speed on the Hybrid Dream Paladin, use an Act 1 Cold Mercenary with Faith for its Fanaticism Aura. Vampire Gaze and Shaftstop provide this Mercenary with a much needed 50% Damage Reduction and Life Leech.

quotes: The Ubers variant specializes in defeating the Uber Bosses, including mini-Ubers such as Lilith; Crushing Blow, Open Wounds, Damage Reduction, Resistances, and Life are priority stats.

You can use a Teleport Charges Amulet for mobility to justify using Chains of Honor for more Damage and All Resistances. Last Wish is ideal in that it provides a source of Life Tap for Life Sustain, Fade for Damage Reduction, All Resistances, and Curse Duration Reduction, and has high Crushing Blow.
Pre-buffing Enchant with Demon Limb is good here. Thundergod's Vigor and stacked Lightning Resistance allows this build to tank Uber Mephisto.

Treachery and Demon Limb are used for pre-buffing, usually prior to taking down the Ubers. Treachery pre-buffs Fade for All Resistances, Curse Length Reduction, and Damage Reduction, while Demon Limb pre-buffs Enchant for increased Attack Rating.

In order to maintain maximum Attack Speed on the Ubers Dream Paladin, use an Act 1 Cold Mercenary with Faith for its Fanaticism Aura. Vampire Gaze and Shaftstop provide this Mercenary with a much needed 50% Damage Reduction and Life Leech.
